native_hotkeys_apps_taken: {owner}. A global hotkey wins over the app in front, so that command stops working everywhere while Atlas runs
native_hotkeys_needs_modifier: A global hotkey needs a modifier ({ctrl}, {alt}, {shift} or {cmd})
native_hotkeys_system_taken: {owner} already uses this key: macOS takes it before Atlas can
native_hotkeys_taken: {stroke} is taken by another app or the system ({reason})
native_hotkeys_unlistenable: "{stroke}" is not a key the system can listen for ({reason})
